decisions.reason: As a very recent, close-in extension of the hearing-products range, it likely costs little to keep available and still has time to prove demand despite only limited website prominence so far.
Its dedicated product page and fit with the firm's established custom hearing solutions suggest enough strategic and commercial promise to keep this option open for at least another year.

The vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm's equipment-and-workflow offering, and in a growing med-tech market the firm is likely to retain this recent launch while learning more about customer uptake.
